description: Regulated service types: the vocabulary the Cedar service-eligibility packs (cedar/service-eligibility/) key on. A pack's serviceType strings are these keys verbatim. Each entry says, per jurisdiction-profiles.json key, whether the activity is reserved to authorised persons, unreserved, or unregulated, and on what statutory basis. A jurisdiction absent from an entry means no pack uses that value there yet, not that the activity is unregulated.

_metadata.source: Legal Services Act 2007; Solicitors (Scotland) Act 1980; Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976
_metadata.assuranceNote: Encoded conservatively and not yet signed off. Each jurisdiction's entries need confirmation by a solicitor qualified in that jurisdiction before a consumer app relies on them.
_metadata.disclaimer: This data is provided for interoperability purposes. It does not constitute legal, tax, or financial advice. Users must verify independently before relying on it for official purposes.

statuses.reserved: Only an authorised or qualified person may carry it on (for reward, where the statute says so).
statuses.unreserved: Anyone may carry it on; it is not a reserved legal activity.
statuses.unregulated: Not a legal activity at all; professional vetting is a matter for the consuming app.

rights_of_audience.label: Rights of audience
rights_of_audience.description: Exercising a right of audience before a court.

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(a) and Sch 2 paras 1-3

conduct_of_litigation.label: Conduct of litigation
conduct_of_litigation.description: Issuing, commencing, prosecuting or defending court proceedings.

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(b) and Sch 2 para 4

reserved_instrument_activities.label: Instruments relating to estate
reserved_instrument_activities.description: Preparing, for reward, instruments or writs relating to land or other property (transfers, charges and the like).

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(c) and Sch 2 para 5

GB-SCT.basis: Solicitors (Scotland) Act 1980 s.32(1)(a): writs relating to heritable or moveable estate

GB-NIR.basis: Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976 art.23: instruments relating to real or personal estate

reserved_probate_activities.label: Probate and administration papers
reserved_probate_activities.description: Preparing the papers on which to found or oppose a grant of probate or letters of administration. This is the deny-line for consumer apps: will-writing is not reserved, grant papers are.

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(d) and Sch 2 para 6

GB-NIR.basis: Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976 art.23: papers on which to found or oppose a grant of probate or of letters of administration

reserved_confirmation_activities.label: Confirmation papers
reserved_confirmation_activities.description: Preparing, for reward, the papers on which to found or oppose an application for confirmation in favour of executors. The Scottish counterpart of probate papers, under a different statute, so a separate value.

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(e) and Sch 2 para 7

administration_of_oaths.label: Administration of oaths
administration_of_oaths.description: Administering oaths and taking affidavits or statutory declarations.

GB-ENG.basis: Legal Services Act 2007 s.12(1)(f) and Sch 2 para 8
Not listed in Legal Services Act 2007 Sch 2

GB-SCT.basis: Solicitors (Scotland) Act 1980 s.32(2)(a) excepts a will or other testamentary writing

GB-NIR.basis: Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976 art.23 excepts a will or other testamentary instrument

estate_administration.label: Estate administration
estate_administration.description: Administering an estate after a death, short of preparing the reserved grant or confirmation papers.

GB-ENG.basis: Reserved only as to the grant papers (Legal Services Act 2007 Sch 2 para 6)

GB-SCT.basis: Reserved only as to the confirmation papers and estate writs (Solicitors (Scotland) Act 1980 s.32(1))

GB-NIR.basis: Reserved only as to the grant papers and estate instruments (Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976 art.23)

iht_advice.label: Inheritance Tax advice
iht_advice.description: Advice on Inheritance Tax, a UK-wide tax under the Inheritance Tax Act 1984. Not a reserved activity anywhere in the UK; a consumer app should still require vetting (professional-body membership, indemnity insurance, AML supervision).

GB-ENG.basis: Tax advice is not a reserved legal activity; Inheritance Tax Act 1984 applies UK-wide

GB-SCT.basis: Tax advice is not a reserved legal activity; Inheritance Tax Act 1984 applies UK-wide

GB-NIR.basis: Tax advice is not a reserved legal activity; Inheritance Tax Act 1984 applies UK-wide

GB-ENG.basis: Not listed in Legal Services Act 2007 Sch 2

GB-SCT.basis: Not named in Solicitors (Scotland) Act 1980 s.32(1); whether preparing a trust deed for reward falls within s.32(1)(a) is to be confirmed by a Scottish solicitor

GB-NIR.basis: Not named in Solicitors (Northern Ireland) Order 1976 art.23; whether preparing a trust instrument for reward falls within it is to be confirmed by a Northern Ireland solicitor
